description:
Successor to fz-k22.22 task 2 (investigated + stopped with evidence; speculative tie-break reverted). materialize_callable_entry_positions silently skips multi-resolution callables. Position-level disambiguation was built and tested and proven impossible: enum_predicate_search and enum_take_drop_split share one consumer executable whose argument remains a type variable, so no TransportPosition fact can choose an entry.

The architecture must carry closure authority in the value. Construction sites are per-grounding and unambiguous; exact entry identities retain the fast path; a multi-surface DispatchSet remains an analysis relation, not a runtime identity. Shared/generic consumers invoke the carried closure ValueRef, which owns its code pointer and capture environment; only statically exact entries are devirtualized.

Authority diagnosis
Callable identity cannot be inferred later from CallableId, capture shape, or a shared consumer position. It must be published with the value through transport packaging. The carrier implementation established this, but exposed a second, distinct correlation loss: in Enum.any?/2, Fn71 passes a closure and collection to shared Fn93. The closure entry identity and collection element domain are correlated at that producer-to-consumer edge, but ingress facts retain only the callable slot. Fn93 later cross-products Entry31 (RawInt input) with an atom element, producing the raw-atom-to-raw-int ABI failure.

Required model
Ingress must retain a correlated callable call surface: value-carried identity plus the semantic invocation-argument domain it travels with through direct calls. Closure-call reachability in a shared consumer must use that relation before native materialization, admitting only compatible identity/argument pairs. Capture-only member filtering, static position stamps, target re-selection, and Dynamic fallback are all unsound because they either lose valid value ownership or recreate the invalid cross-product.

Goal
Restore run/interp/build for enum_predicate_search and enum_take_drop_split, then unblock fz-1ah.11 and the remaining fz-k22 direct-call tickets.

Native representation correction
A native callable boundary must not reuse its executable target FnId as a closure-ABI body. The boundary identity FnId is the closure entry: it receives args/self/continuation, extracts actual capture lanes from self, and invokes the target executable body with plain capture/argument lanes. Compiling target FnId as a closure body makes ordinary direct calls invent a static self; nonzero captures then read the missing-static word and abort. Carrier-aware semantic capture inputs and physical capture representations must be finalized together before this shim is generated.

Capture-grounding correction
CallableFlowFact currently stores one unqualified capture vector separately from unioned callable resolution and surface edges. When a local callable is instantiated at multiple groundings, capture ingress then cross-products one activation's source with another resolution. Capture provenance must be an alternative in the same relation as its resolution and invocation surface; semantic input indices and physical carrier lanes must consume that relation unchanged.

Call-tuple correction
The shared consumer failure is not an input-slot reorder: `DemandedCallEdge.inputs` initially owns one correlated caller/callsite tuple, but `record_call_edge` flattens it into independent incoming slots. Callback identity from one reducer activation can then combine with accumulator/element facts from another. Preserve a minimal edge-owned semantic source tuple for callable ingress/reachability; per-slot ingress remains only the physical ABI fact and must not decide callback specialization.

Closure ABI correction
The generated callable identity is the authoritative ABI boundary between generic closure invocation and a specialized executable. Opaque CallClosure passes only ValueRef arguments, so identity entry argument lanes must be ValueRef and identity lowering must decode them into the target executable's authoritative narrow lanes. Declaring the identity narrow lets tagged references enter RawInt/RawAtom lanes, which the raw-return JIT fixture reproduces as incorrect predicates and pointer-sized final counts. This is distinct from continuation capture; its outer continuation is already provided by the continuation closure plan.

Collapsed prerequisite result
The direct/public inventory split, lazy native boundary derivation, and producer-scoped member relation are one atomic model change. A constructed CallableId may own several specializations sharing one capture surface; a singleton direct identity pins the wrong ABI, while selecting a member from ClosureCall.target recreates consumer-position re-selection. BackendCallableDispatchSet remains callsite analysis only. The final model must carry the producer-owned member set from FunctionRef/Lambda construction, distinguish direct target ABI from actual BoundaryId publication, and mint a boxed closure wrapper only when that value is materialized.

Shared continuation result
The edge tuple must also own the representation boundary in shared consumers. Fn93/reduce_while currently derives a RawInt continuation-state lane from flattened inputs, then receives an atom from a sibling producer. The final model keeps the shared executable and carries its correlated callable/state tuple through explicit boxed carrier lanes keyed by IncomingCallEdgeId; per-slot facts may shape physical ABI but cannot narrow this relation. Callable member reachability reads the edge tuple before target ABI decoding.

Lane authority result\nbuild_executable_abi_plan is the sole semantic-input-to-physical-lane authority. The final model publishes immutable BackendExecutable input layout ranges from that plan, preserves raw IncomingInputSource.edge through transport projection, and derives callable capture/call carrier ABI from semantic input layout rather than slicing param_reprs by physical capture_count. Native and interpreter consume the artifact layout rather than reconstructing it.

Final carrier transport result
Correlated carrier widening is a semantic input transport, not a mutation of old param_reprs. BackendExecutable input layout must rebuild structural entries and CorrelatedCarrier entries together: each carrier semantic input has one ValueRef lane/range and no structural shape decoding at that seam. Native/interpreter entry binding and call encoding branch on this declared transport. The interpreter must also honor Members at ClosureCall rather than requiring a singleton FnId.

Continuation presence result
Carrier ABI finalization must publish semantic input ValueId presence through EntryCapture. A structural Nothing capture may be absent only when its finalized transport is Structural; CorrelatedCarrier has one real ValueRef lane even if the old shape is Nothing. Native/interpreter continuation capture paths consume this declared carrier presence, retaining normal Nothing elision elsewhere.

Carrier propagation result
CorrelatedCarrier is monotonic through direct-call ingress. Seed carrier semantic inputs from edge-owned callable/state tuples, then propagate carrier presence from producer ValueId to callee semantic input through IncomingInputSource until fixed point. Recomputing per callee loses a one-lane carrier on later direct edges and reclassifies it Structural.

Callable surface result
BackendCallableEntry currently slices flattened param_reprs at physical capture_count, which carrier transport invalidates. The final callable surface publishes semantic capture-input count and target input-layout ranges from ABI planning; member grouping validates capture semantic surface. Interpreter/native closure invocation consume that surface rather than deriving capture/argument split from activation arity or physical lane counts.

Lambda capture result
Carrier propagation includes a construction-specific capture edge: if a Lambda captures a CorrelatedCarrier runtime ValueId, its producer member capture semantic input has one ValueRef lane and the member wrapper captures that same value. Do not widen every callable capture prefix; derive this only from actual Lambda capture-to-member surface mapping.
title: fz-k22: shared consumer bodies must dispatch closure calls through the VALUE-carried entry identity -- a static position->entry stamp is unrepresentable for type-variable arg slots
